# Event reference

<!-- Generated by `aios docs reference`. Do not edit: change the code it is made from. -->

Every standard event type. Commands end in `requested` and are consumed by exactly one
handler; facts are broadcast. Each payload's JSON Schema is served at
`/v1/schemas/events/<type>`, and committed under `specs/schemas/events/`.

| Type | Kind | Emitted by | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `app.request.received` | fact | Access layer | A user or trigger asked an App for something. |
| `app.response.ready` | fact | Access layer | The App's response is ready to stream to the caller. *(any payload for now)* |
| `app.consent.requested` | command | Control plane | An App is waiting for a tenant admin to agree. |
| `app.consent.refused` | fact | Control plane | A tenant admin said no to an App. |
| `app.installed` | fact | Control plane | An App was installed into a tenant. |
| `app.upgraded` | fact | Control plane | An installed App moved to a new version. |
| `app.version.restored` | fact | Control plane | An App went back to an earlier version. |
| `app.config.changed` | fact | Control plane | An App's configuration changed. |
| `app.uninstalled` | fact | Control plane | An App was removed from a tenant. |
| `run.started` | fact | Workflow Engine | A workflow run started. |
| `run.paused` | fact | Workflow Engine | A run is waiting (request, approval, signal). |
| `run.resumed` | fact | Workflow Engine | A paused run continued. |
| `run.completed` | fact | Workflow Engine | A run finished successfully. |
| `run.failed` | fact | Workflow Engine | A run failed. |
| `run.cancel.requested` | command | Access layer, Control plane | Asks to cancel a run. |
| `run.cancelled` | fact | Workflow Engine | A run was cancelled. |
| `run.pause.requested` | command | Access layer, Control plane | Asks a run to start no new work until it is resumed. |
| `run.resume.requested` | command | Access layer, Control plane | Asks a held run to continue. |
| `run.signal.requested` | command | Access layer, Control plane | External input for a run (FR-WF-08); the run keeps it until a wait step takes it. |
| `step.scheduled` | fact | Workflow Engine | A step is ready to run. *(any payload for now)* |
| `step.started` | fact | Workflow Engine | A step started. |
| `step.completed` | fact | Workflow Engine | A step finished; its output is recorded. |
| `step.failed` | fact | Workflow Engine | A step failed. |
| `step.retrying` | fact | Workflow Engine | A failed step will be retried. |
| `task.requested` | command | Workflow Engine | Work for any agent that provides the capability (FR-EVT-16). |
| `task.claimed` | fact | Agent Kernel | An agent instance took the task. |
| `task.completed` | fact | Agents (via the SDK) | The task's output. |
| `task.failed` | fact | Agents (via the SDK) | The task failed. |
| `task.suspended` | fact | Agent Kernel | The task stopped to wait for an approval; it runs again once that is decided. |
| `agent.lifecycle.registered` | fact | Agent Kernel | Agent lifecycle transition (FR-AGT-03). |
| `agent.lifecycle.starting` | fact | Agent Kernel | Agent lifecycle transition. |
| `agent.lifecycle.ready` | fact | Agent Kernel | Agent lifecycle transition. |
| `agent.lifecycle.busy` | fact | Agent Kernel | Agent lifecycle transition. |
| `agent.lifecycle.suspended` | fact | Agent Kernel | Agent lifecycle transition. |
| `agent.lifecycle.draining` | fact | Agent Kernel | Agent lifecycle transition. |
| `agent.lifecycle.stopped` | fact | Agent Kernel | Agent lifecycle transition. |
| `agent.lifecycle.failed` | fact | Agent Kernel | Agent lifecycle transition. |
| `agent.emit.stubbed` | fact | Agent Kernel | A replay or fork held back a fact an agent emitted, so that nothing it triggers happens. |
| `model.call.completed` | fact | Model Kernel | Summary of a model call: model, tokens, cost, and the recorded output. |
| `model.call.failed` | fact | Model Kernel | A model call failed after fallbacks. |
| `tool.call.requested` | command | Tool OS | A tool invocation, before the policy decision (an audit record of the request). |
| `tool.call.completed` | fact | Tool OS | A tool returned. |
| `tool.call.failed` | fact | Tool OS | A tool failed or was denied. |
| `memory.item.written` | fact | Memory OS | A memory item was stored. |
| `memory.item.updated` | fact | Memory OS | A memory item has a new version. |
| `memory.recalled` | fact | Memory OS | Someone received memory items. |
| `memory.item.forgotten` | fact | Memory OS | Memory items were erased. |
| `memory.ingest.started` | fact | Memory OS | A document sync began. |
| `memory.document.synced` | fact | Memory OS | A document sync finished. |
| `approval.requested` | command | Workflow Engine, Security Kernel | Asks Human OS for a decision; the step waiting for it stops until it arrives. |
| `approval.granted` | fact | Human OS | The approval was granted. |
| `approval.denied` | fact | Human OS | The approval was denied. |
| `approval.modified` | fact | Human OS | The approver changed the proposed action. |
| `approval.expired` | fact | Human OS | No decision before the timeout. |
| `approval.voted` | fact | Human OS | One of the yeses a quorum needs. |
| `approval.reminded` | fact | Human OS | Approvers were reminded. |
| `approval.escalated` | fact | Human OS | Nobody answered in time: the next tier of approvers was asked as well. |
| `approval.cancelled` | fact | Human OS | The run no longer needs the approval. |
| `human.task.assigned` | fact | Human OS | Work assigned to people. |
| `human.task.completed` | fact | Human OS | A person did the work. |
| `human.task.cancelled` | fact | Human OS | The run no longer needs the work. |
| `human.feedback.given` | fact | Human OS | A person rated or corrected what a run did. |
| `policy.decision.allowed` | fact | Security Kernel | A governed action was allowed. |
| `policy.decision.denied` | fact | Security Kernel | A governed action was denied. |
| `policy.decision.escalated` | fact | Security Kernel | A governed action needs an approval first. |
| `security.injection.suspected` | fact | Security Kernel | Content reaching an agent looks like an injection (FR-SEC-09). |
| `security.key.created` | fact | Security Kernel | An API key was created. |
| `security.group.changed` | fact | Security Kernel | A group's members were set. |
| `security.contact.changed` | fact | Security Kernel | A person set where they are told about approvals. |
| `security.key.revoked` | fact | Security Kernel | An API key was revoked. |
| `security.suspended` | fact | Security Kernel | The kill switch stopped an agent, an App or a tenant (FR-SEC-13). |
| `security.resumed` | fact | Security Kernel | A suspension ended. |
| `budget.warning` | fact | Model Kernel | A soft budget limit was reached. |
| `budget.exceeded` | fact | Model Kernel, Workflow Engine, Event Fabric | A hard budget limit was hit. |
| `eval.experiment.requested` | command | Access layer | Someone asked for an evaluation suite to be run (FR-OBS-07). |
| `eval.experiment.started` | fact | Evaluator | An experiment began. |
| `eval.case.started` | fact | Evaluator | A case of an experiment began. |
| `eval.case.completed` | fact | Evaluator | A case was run and graded. |
| `eval.case.graded` | fact | Access layer | A person graded a case. |
| `eval.experiment.completed` | fact | Evaluator | Every case of an experiment was run. |
| `eval.run.graded` | fact | Evaluator | A sampled production run was graded. |
| `system.dlq.added` | fact | Event Fabric | An event was dead-lettered (FR-EVT-08). |
| `system.consumer.lagging` | fact | Event Fabric | A consumer group is falling behind. *(any payload for now)* |
